events.event_name: National Voter Registration Day NYC Block Party
events.address: Washington Square Park, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: HeadCount's National Voter Registration Day block party in Washington Square Park with voter registration, live music, art and brand activations.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free public admission plus brand freebies and chocolate; individual giveaway quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Multiple current listings agree on Tuesday, September 15, 10 AM–6 PM in Washington Square Park. No advance RSVP requirement is published. Specific brand freebies are promotional and may be supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 10 AM–6 PM. Walk-in public block party in Washington Square Park.

events.what_it_is: A three-day immersive TEMPTATIONS bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC bodega cats, with photo moments, games, product sampling and branded merchandise prizes.
events.what_is_free: Current sources advertise free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples plus chances to win Cat Bodega merchandise through games and scratch-offs.
events.caveats: Current sources agree on September 17–19 at 213 Bowery, 12–6 PM daily, and describe the physical pop-up as free/open to the public. Samples and prize merchandise are promotional and may run out.
events.practical_notes: Thursday through Saturday, September 17–19, noon–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery. No advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.event_name: CookUnity The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas and delis where eight chefs serve complimentary CookUnity meals and hot bites.
events.what_is_free: Anyone who walks into a participating location can receive a complimentary chef-made meal or hot bite while supplies last; guests also receive scratch-off tickets for prize chances.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree on Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five named Manhattan locations and describe the giveaway as open to anyone who walks in. Meals and hot bites are explicitly while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Walk in at any of the five listed bodegas/delis; earlier arrival is prudent because food is while supplies last.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: A three-day Japanese-wellness-inspired Apothékary takeover at SUKOSHI with tongue readings, ingredient education, tincture sampling and kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests in line each day are advertised to receive a mini Apothékary tincture; tincture samples and kakigori are also advertised, with shaved ice while supplies last.
events.caveats: The current event listing gives Friday 1–9 PM and Saturday/Sunday 9 AM–9 PM and links to a live Eventbrite RSVP destination. The source does not establish that RSVP is mandatory, so it is treated as optional rather than guaranteed/required admission. Promotional items are supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: September 18: 1–9 PM. September 19–20: 9 AM–9 PM. RSVP is available; arrive early if the first-50 mini tincture is the priority.

events.event_name: Happy Camp3r: The Sweetest Stop in NYC
events.what_it_is: Happy Camp3r's first NYC pop-up, centered on its comfort-first fashion and mental-health mission, with shopping, sweet treats, photo moments and weekend surprises.
events.what_is_free: Admission is open to the public. Current listings mention sweet treats and surprises but do not establish that any particular item is guaranteed free, so no specific giveaway is promised here.
events.caveats: Current listings agree on September 18–20 at 251 Elizabeth Street and describe the event as open to the public. NYC for FREE lists 10 AM–6 PM for the weekend program. Shopping is a core part of the activation; unspecified treats/surprises are not treated as guaranteed giveaways.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM at 251 Elizabeth Street. Walk-in public shopping pop-up.

events.address: The Brant Foundation, 421 E 6th St, New York, NY 10009
events.what_it_is: An immersive installation by artist Cj Hendry and Sulwhasoo, presenting a forest of flat-pack wooden sculpture inspired by the hidden garden at The House of Sulwhasoo in Seoul.
events.what_is_free: Current listings describe the September 18–20 public viewing as open to the public; no specific product giveaway is promised.
events.caveats: Current listings agree that the public viewing runs September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM at The Brant Foundation, 421 E 6th Street. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the sources reviewed.
events.practical_notes: Friday through Sunday, September 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM. Public art/beauty installation at The Brant Foundation.
